first.speaker: Mayor Tolle
first.text: So. The sea gave one back. We have not had that in a long time.

where.speaker: Mayor Tolle
where.text: Wrackmouth, in the kingdom of Vessary. We pick over what the tide leaves and we mind our own business. Nothing has happened here in years, and I would like it to stay that way.

menu.speaker: Mayor Tolle
menu.text: We are short of hands. I cannot feed a stranger for nothing, and I will not turn one out. Work, if you want to belong here.

accept.speaker: Mayor Tolle
accept.text: There is a rat in the old vaults past the last houses. A giant one. It has taken three dogs and a calf this month, and I will not send my own people down to it. Kill it, and I will count you one of ours.

weapons.speaker: Mayor Tolle
weapons.text: You will not do it bare-handed. The Hall keeps old arms in the cupboard. Take one, and choose well; you will not be given a second.

armed.speaker: Mayor Tolle
armed.text: Good. Nobody here will thank you for it. That is not the same as nobody noticing.

hunt_reminder.speaker: Mayor Tolle
hunt_reminder.text: The rat, in the old vaults past the last houses. Come back when it is dead.

report.speaker: Mayor Tolle
report.text: Dead? Then the dogs can sleep. Twenty-five coin, and my thanks, which is rarer.

after.speaker: Mayor Tolle
after.text: You came to us a stranger. Wrackmouth remembers who stayed to work. Whatever you find out there, you have a door here.
